name: Garan Shigataaru Kurain
original_name: ガラン・シガタール・クライン
source: The current queen of Kingdom of Khura'in who ascended the throne following the death of her older sister, the previous queen. She is the one who passed the Defense Culpability Act in an effort to bring the criminals to justice.
translation: The current queen of Kingdom of Khura'in who ascended the throne following the death of her older sister, the previous queen. She is the one who passed the Defense Culpability Act in an effort to bring the criminals to justice.
